snippet.title: Wildsite - Official Trailer | Mundo Gamer Showcase 2026 - Edition 01
snippet.description:
Crash-landed on a hostile planet… how long can you survive?

Wildsite is a survival adventure where you explore a dangerous alien world filled with plasma storms, strange creatures, and constant threats.

With your sarcastic AI companion Bob, build, explore, and adapt alone or with up to 3 friends in co-op.

🛒 Add it to your Steam wishlist:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2649120/Wildsite/


🚀 About the Game

🌌 Survival on an Alien Planet
• Explore a handcrafted world filled with mysteries and dangers
• Face extreme weather conditions and plasma storms

🤖 Meet Bob
• Your sarcastic AI companion
• Constantly comments on your decisions while you try to survive

🏠 Build and Carry Your Base
• Create and customize your own home
• Shrink and carry your base wherever you go

🔫 Tools, Weapons and Chaos
• Use plasma weapons and multi-tool lasers
• Gather resources and craft essential equipment

💥 Resource Grenades
• Turn explosions into valuable loot
• Use creative tools to optimize survival

🐾 Creatures and Taming
• Capture and tame alien creatures
• Turn them into companions in your journey

🌍 Exploration and Discovery
• Find hidden caves, ruins, and secrets
• Explore diverse biomes across the planet

👥 Co-op Experience
• Play solo or with up to 4 players
• Survive together in a constantly evolving world
